question.text: Will the Detroit Red Wings beat the Florida Panthers in their November 12, 2026 game?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves YES if the Detroit Red Wings are the winning team in their NHL regular-season game against the Florida Panthers scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026 (7:30 p.m. ET) at Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise, Florida. The result is read from the official final score on the NHL's scores page for that date: https://www.nhl.com/scores/2026-11-12. A win in regulation, overtime, or a shootout all resolve YES; a loss in regulation, overtime, or a shootout all resolve NO. If that page is unavailable or does not show this game, the result shown for this game on the Red Wings' official schedule page (https://www.nhl.com/redwings/schedule) or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.
question.fine_print: If the game is postponed, suspended, or otherwise not completed by 11:59 p.m. ET on November 12, 2026, this question resolves as Annulled.
